{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorfield trips''' were a specialized form of [[sensor trip]] that detected [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] fields. Often connected to [[Anti-vehicle mine/Legends|vehicle mines]], it was a key part of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] security strategy. [[Zone Supplies, Ltd.]] manufactured the [[Repulsor Trip]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
